Finding: Almost half of African-affiliated articles were free to read in August 2022.

Finding: The yearly share of open articles more than tripled in twenty years.
Most open articles are published in fully open journals (Gold).
Open access differs widely between African regions.
Country shares range from under a third to over three quarters.
Uncertainty and scope: 54 countries; mean 57.7%, SD 11.2; small countries (<500 articles) vary more

Finding: Articles with a co-author outside Africa are more often open.
Funded articles are more often open than unfunded ones.
Uncertainty and scope: Funding = WoS Funding Orgs field not empty; under-recorded before 2008; descriptive
